abilities._comment: When this defends, you may turn a face-down card with crush in your arsenal face-up; if you do, put a +1{p} counter on it. Temper is an engine keyword (card DB). Composed: LOOK_AT filters the arsenal to face-down crush cards, then a MAY block selects one, flips it face-up, and counters it.

effects.prompt: Turn a face-down crush card in your arsenal face-up?
